name: use-disclosure
title: useDisclosure
description: Open and closed state with open, close and toggle functions, and callbacks when it changes.
a11y: No DOM output. Pair with aria-expanded and aria-controls on the trigger.
Callbacks run only when the state actually changes, not on mount.

props.name: onOpen
props.description: Called when the state changes from closed to open. Not called on mount.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Called when the state changes from open to closed. Not called on mount.
